architectural-decision-records.why: records the provenance decision, the two option sets, and the deferred scope
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0044: committed manifest must match the published upstream release; immutable release asset as the anchor, base-branch + CODEOWNERS self-protection, origin/consumer modes, with scope and limits stated
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the provenance gate ships a discrimination test and was proven to fail when neutralized
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added check-manifest-provenance.mjs and a 14-case fixture test; confirmed 11 of 14 cases go red when the gate is forced to exit 0
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds executable code (.mjs), so the test level is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: a fixture-driven test comparing a committed manifest against a stand-in published manifest is the right level; the live network fetch is left to CI, documented in the ADR
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the added .mjs; the behavior is already committed as Gherkin
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: implements the check-manifest-provenance runner the malicious-actor forged-manifest scenario assumes, with a discrimination test
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the gate verifies the provenance of a security-critical artifact fetched from an external source
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: reads and compares only (executes no PR code), fails closed when it cannot reach or parse the upstream, and treats an unsanctioned upstream-origin insertion as a forge
quotes: For the change in front of you, look up the matching sheet in the catalog below

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the scope cut and the limits rather than overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: documented that the release-publish workflow, immutable-releases setting, and repo-A wiring are deferred to the dogfood step, and that origin mode does not prevent a version decrement
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: will run a fresh-context judge-arch review over the gate, its test, CODEOWNERS, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: a CI verification script; no system, data, or resilience architecture change

pattern-selector.why: no design pattern selected; a read-and-compare verification

release-deployment-safety.why: the release-publish workflow and immutable-releases setting are deferred to the dogfood step; this PR deploys and migrates nothing

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration

arch-encode.why: planned enforcement machinery, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake
